title: Cantilever beam, hex20
sentence: The same cantilever at quadratic order (hex20) — bending accuracy from one lattice mesh setting.
theory: The same $\delta = \dfrac{PL^3}{3EI} = 0.1905\,\mathrm{mm}$ as `cantilever`, reached with quadratic elements: hex20 represents the linear bending strain exactly, so it does not need the incompatible modes hex8 relies on.
